senses.gloss: , (דיגמטורי) m. pl. (a transpos. of διαγράμματα; cmp. גִּימַטְרְיָא) plans, designs.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 11:10">Gen. R. s. 11</cite> <he>מראה לאלו מעין ד׳ שלהן וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>דוגמא גטורין</he>, some ed. in one w., corr. acc.; Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 33 <he>מעין דוגמא שלהם</he>) He shows to these (the righteous) something corresponding to their designs (reward) and to those &c. Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 (ref. to <cite ref="Job 36:7">Job XXXVI, 7</cite>) the Lord refuses not to the righteous man <he>ד׳ שלו</he> a realization of his designs (ideals), v. <cite ref="D00190">preced.</cite>
